title: Deformation of the shells onto the skeleton: assembly of push-forwards, homotopies, estimates and limits
statement: Assume (IMS) (exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_fc_im_series, as an antecedent). Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let push_k, homot_k be operations on currents on univ satisfying the five clauses PF(1)–PF(5) of the frozen dor_lmb_fcd_pushforward_homotopy (identity, linearity, locality, integrality/mass/vanishing (4) with M(push_k(F, X)) ≤ Λ^k M(X), vanishing off F(E), homot_k(F, G, X) vanishing off {F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) : x ∈ E, t ∈ [0,1]} and M(homot_k(F, G, X)) ≤ δ(2Λ)^k M(X) when |F − G| ≤ δ on E, and boundary/homotopy formula (5)). Let c, c₄, C ∈ ℝ with c₄ ≥ 0, C ≥ 0, c₄^{m+1}(1 + 2C) ≤ c, √P(2c₄)^{m+1}(1 + 2C) ≤ c, c₄^m(1 + 2C) ≤ c and √P(2c₄)^m(1 + 2C) ≤ c. Let T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with M(T) ≠ ∞, M(∂T) ≠ ∞; ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P; compact E_j ⊆ ℝ^P with E_j ⊆ E_{j+1}; φ_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^P Λ_j-Lipschitz with 1 ≤ Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1} and Λ_j ≤ c₄2^j; φ_j = ψ on E_j; |ψ(x) − x| ≤ √P for x ∈ E_j; ψ(E_j) ⊆ F₁; x + t(ψ(x) − x) ∈ F₂ for x ∈ E_j and t ∈ [0, 1]; IM W_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) and IM D_j, Z_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P), all vanishing off E_j, with ∂W_0 = D_0 − Z_0 and ∂W_{j+1} = D_{j+1} + Z_j − Z_{j+1} pointwise; A_N ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with Σ_{j≤N} W_j(ω) = T(ω) − A_N(ω); M(W_0) ≤ M(T), M(W_{j+1}) ≤ C(1/2)^{(j+2)(m+2)}M(T), M(D_0) ≤ M(∂T), M(D_{j+1}) ≤ C(1/2)^{(j+2)(m+2)}M(∂T), M(Z_j) ≤ 4C(1/2)^{(j+2)(m+1)}M(T) (coefficients via ENNReal.ofReal), and M(A_N) → 0. Then there are IM Q ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), R₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P), S₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with T(ω) − Q(ω) = ∂R₁(ω) + S₁(ω) for all ω, M(Q) ≤ cM(T), M(∂Q) ≤ cM(∂T), M(R₁) ≤ cM(T), M(S₁) ≤ cM(∂T), Q vanishing off F₁ and R₁, S₁ vanishing off F₂.
